game_concept: A survival strategy set in Sand Dunes – Mirage Road, a road of shimmering mirages: the scarab scholar must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Exception Rodeo: Wrap risky code in try/except to catch runtime errors without crashing.
theme: Sand Dunes – Mirage Road: a road of shimmering mirages
core_gameplay_loop: In Mirage Road, repeat each round: Wrap risky code in try/except to catch runtime errors without crashing. Each round, desert bandits strike the caravan wagon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stability value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the caravan wagon from desert bandits in Mirage Road: keep the stability meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: stability drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Exception Rodeo
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exception Rodeo' (Week 9 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Mirage Road'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stability changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against desert bandits in Mirage Road.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while stability > 0.
